title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Does rotation conjugacy for every pair of parallel directions characterize ellipses? Does projective conjugacy for every pair of pencils whose joining line meets the oval also characterize ellipses?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200014 (AMR-051-0014). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Serge Tabachnikov, Problem 2, pp. 10--11.
